title: Contact and Ghost
author: Jonah Oyelaran
blurb: Odile Eastwick, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
